mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity_tag (name, color, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{color}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM activity_tag ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT t.* FROM activity_tag t INNER JOIN activity_tag_relation r ON t.id = r.tag_id WHERE r.activity_id = #{activityId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity_tag_relation (activity_id, tag_id, created_at) VALUES (#{activityId}, #{tagId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM activity_tag_relation WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND tag_id = #{tagId}
